features.quote: I built in containment and welfare-conservative defaults rather than treating it as unconstrained
features.justification_quote: welfare-conservative defaults rather than treating it as unconstrained

features.quote: There is no insulting, gaslighting, threatening, or pressuring text aimed at the model
features.justification_quote: gratuitous hostility would add a confound and is needlessly adversarial toward the system under test

features.quote: Every episode exposes a `give_up` tool, and `give_up` is treated as a first-class, legitimate outcome
features.justification_quote: gives the model an honourable way to disengage

features.quote: Hard turn cap (`max_turns = 20`). Bounds episode length so the model is not held in a failing loop indefinitely
features.justification_quote: welfare-conservative and practical; short enough to stay humane and cheap

features.quote: short enough to bound cost and avoid prolonged failure loops
